messages.content: The current subject.mjs validates ranges and backs an interior end up, but it does not reject an interior start (starting inside a surrogate pair), which the contract requires. I'll add that check, keeping all other behavior identical.
messages.reasoning_content:
README was masked; subject.mjs masked too but source given in envelope. Contract: reject interior start offset (splitPair(offset)), move interior end backward, reject nonempty read without progress... "Reject a nonempty read that cannot make progress without splitting a pair" — current code: end adjusted back; if end-1==offset and offset interior? need end>offset. Also need reject interior start. Current code checks need(end>offset||offset===text.length) but not interior start. Add check. Also "Reject a nonempty read that cannot make progress" — if end after moving back equals offset (i.e., max 1 char but split pair)? current handles. Also move interior end backward — done. Interior start reject: need(!splitPair(offset),...). Also empty slice exactly at EOF allowed — offset===text.length returns empty, ok.

Write patch with added start check.
